meta.title: Pricing — VNGOWEB
meta.description: Compare VNGOWEB plans: Free, WebPro and Ultra — pick the right plan to build a professional website for your business.

heading: VNGOWEB Pricing
subheading: No hidden fees. Secure payments via PayOS (bank transfer/VietQR).

price.renewalApplied: Renewal price — you've used this plan before

free.name: Starter (Free)
free.desc: The perfect way to start building a website for your small shop or retail counter.
features: Up to 1 published website + 2 draft sites
Website URL on the vngoweb.com domain
VNGOWEB badge shown in the website corner

pro.name: WebPro Business
pro.desc: For shop and brand owners ready to accelerate their sales.
features: Up to 1 published website + 4 drafts at once
Unlock discounted pricing — many templates become cheaper or free
Completely remove the VNGOWEB logo & watermark

ultra.name: Ultra Brand
ultra.desc: Our top-tier plan — built for store chains and growing brands.
features: Up to 3 published websites + 15 drafts at once
Best pricing tier — many premium templates unlocked for free

templatePerk.title: Upgrading also unlocks template discounts
templatePerk.desc: Each template can have its own Pro/Ultra pricing — upgrading may unlock discounted or completely free access to premium templates in the Marketplace.
